budget.bytes: the whole VTSP file (int8 weights, int32 biases, requantisation constants, headers); the int8 weight count is reported
budget.time: the A9 cycle model's high bound x 1.0007 at 333 MHz for the shape and scale on the runtime of the blob's version (default call, dark pass included), plus 1.4 ms per horizontal box at the arm's median on the development Vita frames for det+refine
budget.arena: the runtime's *_arena_bytes(m, 960, 544) (any frame up to 960 x 544); for det+refine the larger of it and the refinement's 72,391 B
budget.parity: the C runtime gives the twin's boxes on every development frame
budget.report: 444 MHz (x 333/444), the PSP's 480x272, VitaSDK -Os code sizes, the stack peak

protocol.estimates: the A9 cycle model as textspot: the Vita compiler's code of the runtime of the blob's version (vocr_textspot2.c for T, vocr_textspot3.c for M), random blobs of each shape, textspot's pinned procedural frames at 960x544 and 480x272, vita/a9_cycles.py; tables pinned by an amendment before any score

textspot3.title: textspot3: the A9 table of record of the registered shapes (family M on runtime/vocr_textspot3.c; family T and textspot2's d2s shapes on runtime/vocr_textspot2.c)

stack.how: stack: the peak stack of each public function of runtime/vocr_textspot3.c, and for reference of the frozen runtime/vocr_textspot2.c, from gcc -fcallgraph-info=su over the spotter and vocr_lines.c / vocr_lines_rows.c (whose vocr_line_dark gives the dark flags): VitaSDK gcc -O2 and -Os (Thumb-2, NEON), psp-gcc -O2 -G0 and -Os -G0. Every frame must be static; the peak is the heaviest path through the call graph across the three files (psp/stack.py's parser); calls outside them (memcpy, memset, libgcc) are listed, their frames not counted.

rule_reads.arena: arena_up_to_960 = vocr_textspot_arena_bytes(m, 960, 544): every frame up to 960x544 (for h2, the 600-px frame read at full size dominates); arena_frame_960 = vocr_textspot_frame_arena_bytes(m, 960, 544), the 960x544 frame's own need, is report only (the conductor, 2026-10-19)
rule_reads.time: ms_333_960: the default call (flags 0, the dark pass included) on the pinned 960x544 grey frame; ms_333_960_nodark (VOCR_TEXTSPOT_NO_DARK) is report only
rule_reads.within_limits: textspot3's budget, for det: vtsp_bytes <= vtsp_max, ms_333_960 <= ms_max_333_960 and arena_up_to_960 <= arena_max; det+refine adds 1.4 ms per refined horizontal box and the refinement's 72,391-B arena
